request: Make from_iter start from the current working directory when supplied with zero inputs, so our job does not silently do nothing when its input list is blank.

source.request: Make from_iter start from the current working directory when supplied with zero inputs, so our job does not silently do nothing when its input list is blank.
source.settled: WalkBuilder::from_iter yields an empty walk for an empty iterator, producing zero items.
source.why: Searching the current directory for zero inputs violates the explicitly empty traversal behavior.
